component.name: Keybox
component.summary: Inspect the passwords and secrets stored in your desktop keyring

description.p: Keybox shows which application credentials are stored in your desktop keyring and lets you inspect a selected entry. You can also create and edit text entries, delete entries, and manage keyrings. It works with any provider of the freedesktop Secret Service, such as oo7 or GNOME Keyring.
Keybox is not affiliated with System76.

ul.li: Browse keyrings and entries without reading any secret
Reveal and copy secrets, hidden and cleared again after a timeout
Create, edit and delete text entries; create, rename and delete empty keyrings
Lock and unlock keyrings, with a built-in password prompt on desktops that have none, such as COSMIC
Tested with oo7 0.6 and GNOME Keyring 51.1
